narrative.overview: The creative-agency canon played straight at full craft: near-black ground, enormous condensed Archivo display, one acid lime that owns whole regions, and motion that rewards scrolling. Every effect serves trust and conversion; with motion off the page is still complete.
keyCharacteristics: Archivo 800 uppercase at wdth 84, breathing with scroll
Cursor-reactive WebGL field in the hero
Real client screenshots in device frames
Masked expo-out reveals, Lenis, pinned scenes

rules.name: The Region Rule
rules.body: Lime fills regions or stays out.

rules.name: The Client Colour Rule
rules.body: Case studies switch their accent to the client's brand colour.

rules.name: The Breathing Width Rule
rules.body: Display width follows scroll velocity from 84 to ~96; size narrow-column headings with headroom.

rules.name: The Recede Rule
rules.body: Stacked panels recede with scale and brightness, never opacity.

dos: Do let lime own whole regions
Do show real client screenshots in frames
Do give every animation a readable reduced-motion state
Do theme selection, scrollbar and focus
donts: Don't add eyebrows, kickers or empty section counters
Don't use gradient text or decorative glass
Don't fade stacked panels with opacity
Don't ship placeholder prices or testimonials as final
